content.text: Selling a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-stack-started-generating|COREMERCH guide to payment]] layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-tron-usdt-payments-5|Everything You]]-you-need-know-about-lemon-squeezy-alternatives-2|everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store utilizing no-KYC payments is an infrastructure solution that allows creators to sell ebooks, courses, and templates without the hurdles imposed by traditional platforms. In regions where payment processors are inaccessible, this model empowers creators to retain ownership of their data and revenue. By leveraging cryptocurrency for transactions, creators sidestep the fees and limitations associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges a steep 10% on each sale compared to NOWPayments' low 0.5%. This price efficiency translates into substantial savings, especially for those with high sales volumes.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store involves integrating several key components. It typically utilizes hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for product delivery. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can automate backend processes, ensuring smooth operation. For payment processing, NOWPayments handles cryptocurrency transactions instantly, confirming payments without requiring customer identification. This stack not only minimizes reliance on external platforms but also ensures that creators retain complete control over their sales process and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions with limited access to conventional payment solutions, including but not limited to Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. These individuals are looking for reliable means to monetize their digital goods without incurring high transaction fees or losing access to their funds. By employing a no-KYC payment system, creators can effectively reach global markets while maintaining sovereignty over their business operations and financial transactions, free from the constraints of traditional payment gateways.
Retain 99.5% of your revenue with NOWPayments compared to competitors like Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of a no-KYC digital product store include a hosting platform, a backend automation tool, a payment processor, and a delivery mechanism. Hosting platforms like GitHub Pages offer free storage for your products, while backend tools like Cloudflare Workers enable seamless transaction processing. NOWPayments provides a user-friendly crypto payment solution, ensuring that creators can accept various cryptocurrencies without the burden of KYC regulations. This cohesive architecture allows for a streamlined experience for both creators and customers, ultimately fostering a more accessible digital marketplace.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own no-KYC digital product store, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages. Next, set up Cloudflare Workers for backend automation to manage orders. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments in various digital currencies. Finally, test your setup with a few products to ensure everything functions correctly. With the right infrastructure, you can launch your store and start selling products without the constraints of traditional payment systems. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the blueprints and templates you need.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Empower your sales with complete data ownership and transaction control.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell ebooks without using PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell ebooks by using a no-KYC payment processor like NOWPayments, which allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly. This eliminates the need for traditional payment platforms, enabling smoother transactions.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Utilize a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup minimizes fees and retains your revenue compared to platforms that charge high transaction fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by deploying your own digital product store using a no-KYC payment solution, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, thus avoiding their fees.
How does NOWPayments work for digital product sales?

NOWPayments allows creators to accept cryptocurrency payments without requiring KYC verification. Payments are processed automatically, and funds are deposited directly into your wallet, giving you complete ownership of your revenue.
What infrastructure do I need to set up a digital product store?

You need a hosting platform for your products, a backend automation tool for order management, and a payment processor like NOWPayments. This combination allows for seamless sales and delivery of digital goods.
